CREATE TABLE entry_metric ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, metric_type_id BIGINT NOT NULL, diary_entry_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_entry_metric_type FOREIGN KEY (metric_type_id) REFERENCES dictionary_item (id), CONSTRAINT fk_entry_metric_entry FOREIGN KEY (diary_entry_id) REFERENCES diary_entry (id) );
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_metric_entry ON entry_metric (diary_entry_id); CREATE INDEX idx_entry_metric_type ON entry_metric (metric_type_id);
